hooks.command: d="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; f="$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --absolute-git-dir)/heimdesk-guard-$$.mjs"; git -C "$d" show HEAD:scripts/security/gate.mjs > "$f" 2>/dev/null || cp "$d/scripts/security/gate.mjs" "$f"; HEIMDESK_GATE_ROOT="$d" node "$f" claude-guard; s=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $s
